verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API for every instance, with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api. It covers workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions, authenticated by named user API tokens with expiration, alongside an HTTP ingestion API. The probe's 404s were at guessed spec paths rather than the documented /api location, so they do not contradict the API's existence. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Management API, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec confirmed at a fetchable path.
